primitives.name: Sitemap Density Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Sitemap density** | Cap preview URLs at 120; only SCHEDULED/LIVE in ±3d/21d window; drop FINAL flood
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'N_{\\text{preview}}': 'dimensionless count of preview URLs', 'T_{\\text{window}}': 'time interval in days'}
primitives.assumptions: Preview URL set is finite and bounded by time window constraints.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When $ N_{\text{preview}} > 120 $ or $ T_{\text{window}} \not\in [3, 21] $, drop FINAL flood.

primitives.name: Content Security Policy Integrity
primitives.verbatim_quote: | | **Full CSP** | Baseline CSP on main routes (next.config + vercel.json); embed keeps frame-ancestors
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'CSP_{\\text{baseline}}': 'dimensionless policy strength index', 'frame_ancestors': 'boolean flag indicating embed safety'}
primitives.assumptions: Baseline CSP is enforced on all main routes and embeds maintain frame-ancestors.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If $ CSP_{\text{baseline}} < 1 $ or $ \neg frame_ancestors $, policy breach occurs.

layer2.mapping: Enforces integrity kernel over route access control.

layer2.mapping: Encodes long-term memory kernel for system evolution.
